item.title: Cells move 10/43: roadmap moves into packages/roadmap behind shims
item.criterion: Cells move 10 of 43 (RFC 0006; plan entry 10 in bin/cells-plan.json): the 3 paths the entry lists for package roadmap move with git mv to their planned targets under packages/roadmap, and packages/roadmap/index.js is the front door, re-exporting the 3 modules other code imports. Each of those old paths keeps a re-export shim; nothing else outside the cell changes except path-map.json and the cell lint baseline. First the import from earlier cells into it that the entry lists as cuts is gone, each cut by an item in the importing cell, so no cycle between cells forms. The cell lint counts change as the entry states (legacySource 0, shims +3, boundaries +2) and none rises; node bin/cells-plan.js --moved roadmap passes, and the full suite passes on Node 22.13 and 24.
